title: APPROVE THE SECOND AMENDMENT TO AGREEMENT NO. 707 WITH TRIFILETTI CONSULTING, LLC FOR AN ADDITIONAL TWO-YEAR PERIOD AND ADDITIONAL FUNDING
text:
RESOLUTION NO. ____________ - APPROVE THE SECOND AMENDMENT TO AGREEMENT NO. 707 WITH TRIFILETTI CONSULTING, LLC FOR AN ADDITIONAL TWO-YEAR PERIOD AND ADDITIONAL FUNDING
Transmittal 1
Transmittal 2
Summary
: Staff requests approval of the Second Amendment (Amendment) to Agreement No. 707 (Agreement) between the City of Los Angeles Harbor Department (Harbor Department) and Trifiletti Consulting, LLC (Trifiletti) for consulting and professional assistance in commercial planning, analysis and technical real estate services to augment existing staffing resources including, but not limited to, the proposed Pier 500 Container Terminal Project (Project). The proposed Amendment will i) extend the Agreement by two years for a total aggregate term of three years; and ii) increase the not-to-exceed compensation authority amount from $150,000 to $287,500. The Harbor Department will continue to be financially responsible for payment of costs incurred under the Agreement. This item is not tied to a Strategic Objective as it is purely administrative.
Recommendation
: Board resolve to 1) find that the Director of Environmental Management has determined that the proposed action is administratively exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Article II Section 2(f) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines; 2) find that in accordance with the Los Angeles City Charter Section 1022 the Harbor Department does not employ sufficient personnel to perform the required services, which are more feasibly and economically undertaken on a temporary basis by an independent contractor; 3) approve the Second Amendment to Agreement No. 707 between the City of Los Angeles Harbor Department and Trifiletti Consulting, LLC; 4) authorize the Executive Director to execute, and the Board Secretary to attest to, the Second Amendment to Agreement No. 707; and 5) adopt Resolution No. ______________.
Cargo & Industrial Real Estate
